description: [Paid-only, $0.10 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/inheritance-shares with x402.] South Korea statutory inheritance shares and forced-heirship reserve (yuryubun) under the Civil Code: heirs by rank (children, then parents, then siblings), the spouse 50% add-on, and reserved portions (1/2 of the share for children and spouse, 1/3 for parents, none for siblings). Representation (daeseup) and heirs beyond siblings are not modeled.

children.description: Number of children (lineal descendants of the nearest degree)

parents.description: Number of surviving parents (lineal ascendants of the nearest degree); inherit only if there are no children

siblings.description: Number of siblings; inherit only if there is no spouse, child or parent

spouse.description: Surviving legally married spouse; default false

name: inheritance_shares
